gloss: to dream of; to fantasize about; to imagine idly

definitions.gloss: to dream of; to fantasize about; to imagine idly
definitions.explanation: To indulge in unrealistic or fanciful thoughts about something, often something unlikely or impractical.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{平和|へいわ}を{夢想|むそう}する。
{子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}、{宇宙|うちゅう}{飛行士|ひこうし}になることを{夢想|むそう}していた。
examples.english: As a child, I used to fantasize about becoming an astronaut.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はいつも{窓|まど}の{外|そと}を{見|み}ながら{遠|とお}い{国|くに}での{生活|せいかつ}を{夢想|むそう}している。
examples.english: He is always gazing out the window, fantasizing about life in a faraway country.

notes:
A literary word that implies idle, unrealistic daydreaming or fantasizing. It often carries a slightly romantic or impractical nuance — the thing being dreamed of is typically distant, grand, or unlikely. The noun form {夢想|むそう} appears in compounds like {夢想家|むそうか} (dreamer, fantasist).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夢想|むそう}にふける: to be lost in daydreams
- {夢想家|むそうか}: a dreamer; a fantasist
- {夢想|むそう}の{世界|せかい}: a world of fantasy
- {壮大|そうだい}な{夢想|むそう}: a grand fantasy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}る: to dream (while sleeping) — literal dreaming during sleep
- {空想|くうそう}する: to daydream; to imagine — similar but more neutral; less literary than {夢想|むそう}
- {妄想|もうそう}する: to have delusions; to fantasize — carries a more negative connotation of irrational or obsessive fantasy
